name: Sarna Cleaner
paste:
SARNA® CLEANER: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sarna® Cleaner, April 2023, Version 02.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/2/sarna_cleaner.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sarna® Cleaner where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.02).
1.2 Product description. Mixture of high volatile solvents
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Sarna® Cleaner is used to remove heavy soiling from the seam area of Sarnafil® G/S (PVC) membranes. It is also used to remove adhesive residues from Sarnafil® G/S membranes and to clean tools. Sarna® Cleaner is also suitable for diluting Sarnacol® 2170 adhesive and degreasing metal sheets.
    - Caution: Sarna® Cleaner will remove the lacquer coating from Sarnafil® EL membranes.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sarna® Cleaner
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Cleaner for heavily soiled Sarnafil® G/S
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - Quality management system EN ISO 9001
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN ISO 9001: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Dissolves contamination of adhesive resin, mastic and bitumen
    - Evaporates quickly
    - Highly flammable
    - Suitable for heavily stained seam overlaps of Sarnafil® G/S membranes
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Mixture of high volatile solvents
    - Appearance and colour: Transparent
    - Density: ~0.9 kg/l (+20 °C)
    - Volatile organic compound (VOC) content: VOC-CH: 100 %; VOC-EU: 100 %
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Consistency: Liquid
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Shelf life: 24 months from date of production if stored properly in original, unopened and undamaged sealed container. Expiry date on container.
    - Storage conditions: Store in dry conditions at temperatures between 0 °C and + 30 °C. The product is highly flammable: Safety regulations regarding storage and handling of dangerous goods must be observed.
2.8 Packaging.
    | Tin | 5 l, 10 l |
    | Packing unit | Europallet or single tin |

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 02.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application - Application Guidline. Based on the valid installation instructions of the relevant roof waterproofing membrane.
4.3 Application - Application Method. Cleaner: Soak a clean white cloth with Sarna® Cleaner and then clean the membrane, tool or metal sheet. The cloths should be changed frequently to avoid the spreading of dirt. When cleaning seams a new cloth is to be used. In the seam areas allow Sarna® Cleaner to evaporate completely before the welding of seams. Adhesive dilutant: See the Product Data Sheet of Sarnacol® 2170 for more information.
4.4 Cleaning of equipment. Tools and equipment must be cleaned immediately after use.
4.5 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Dissolves thermoplastics not resistant to solvents (e.g. polystyrene, polycarbonate, acrylics)
    - Do not use the cleaner to wash large areas of roof surface.
    - Sarna® Cleaner reduces the seam quality and should only be used on heavily soiled areas.
    - White cloths will effectively absorb dirt and the colour will not stain the membrane. Use solvent resistant gloves and eye protection glasses during application.
    - Sarna® Cleaner contains high volatile and flammable solvents. Application in closed rooms is allowed only with sufficient room ventilation. Smoking and open fire are not permitted.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. At least -30 °C
5.3 Substrate temperature. At least -20 °C
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sarna® Cleaner, April 2023, Version 02.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/2/sarna_cleaner.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
